title: Ice Bolt
problem: The text always afflicts Frozen. The code only applies Frozen when the spell's calculated damage on that target is above 0, everywhere (not just in the Arena). A target whose Defense soaks the whole hit is never frozen. Frost Arrow has no such check.
notes: Text: Target takes a small amount of damage and is afflicted with {CONDNAME_DEBUFF_FROZEN}. Evidence: bc_CreatureCast L15535 bc_SpellDamage per target @0x1409bd92e; L15548 `damage[k] > 0` (>int @0x1409be07d, je 0x1409be616 @0x1409be087, bytes 0F 84 89 05 00 00) gates bc_EventDebuff(21) at L15550. Fix sketch: Byte edit: NOP the 6-byte je at 0x1409be087 (0F 84 89 05 00 00 -> 66 0F 1F 44 00 00) so L15549-L15550 (Frozen) runs for every target. Frozen still goes through bc_EventDebuff, so immunity and resist rolls keep working. Reasoning: The text makes an unconditional claim (afflicted with Frozen); the code adds a damage > 0 condition the text never mentions, and the sibling Frost Arrow has none. Removing the test makes the code match the text. App note (unpatched game): Ice Bolt only freezes a target if its calculated damage on that target is above 0, so a target whose Defense blocks the whole hit is not frozen. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26). | Patch (batch L): byte edit, bc_CreatureCast L15548 je @0x1409be087 (6 bytes) -> 6-byte NOP, so L15549-L15550 (bc_EventDebuff 21) run for every target. No code is skipped.

release_notes.intended: The target takes a small amount of damage and is afflicted with Frozen.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the target was only afflicted with Frozen if the spell's damage on it was above 0, so a target whose Defense absorbed the whole hit was never frozen.
release_notes.fix: Now the target is always afflicted with Frozen (immunity and resists still apply).
